new_information_channel: exact archimedean-channel comparison between the finite CCM matrix and the Weil explicit-formula Gram of the truncated-character family; the pole and prime channels cancel identically, so no zero sums and no zero tail enter the measurement
source_formula: WeilGram - 2M = ArchLit + 2*arch_component, with closed-form h_{nm}(r) derived and validated against direct quadrature; K_{nm}(y) = q_basis(n,m,|y|,L)

input.arch_quadrature: finite window R=3000, 240 panels, plus analytic non-oscillatory tail (4/L)(log(R/2pi)+1)/R

key_results.closed_form_h_validated: h_closed matches direct quadrature; pole channel 2h(i/2) = 2*pole_component to 1e-16..1e-18 (DERIVED, not merely observed)
key_results.structural_explanation: K_{nm}(0) = 2*delta_{nm}; the archimedean kernel e^{-x/2}/(1-e^{-2x}) is logarithmically singular at 0, so only the diagonal needs regularization, and R004 supplies it with the index-independent constants c_correction(L) + w_correction(L). The shift is therefore structural, not accidental.

bounded_claim.statement: For the truncated-character test family, the Weil explicit-formula Gram and the R004 finite CCM matrix differ, numerically and to machine precision at four values of lambda, by exactly the scalar matrix 4*c_correction(L)*I: WeilGram = 2M + 4*c_correction(L)*I. The pole channel of this comparison is derived in closed form rather than merely observed. No identity is proved and no RH consequence follows.

nonclaims: No CCM/Weil identity is proved; the relation is numerical at finitely many (lambda, n, m).
No RH evidence, no RH route closure, no promotion of C_RH.
The Lean transfer theorems are CONDITIONAL: they carry the relation as an explicit hypothesis.
rank <= 2 for a finite matrix implies nothing about any infinite operator (J6 untouched).
open_obligations: Prove the relation. Blocked: K_{nm} is only piecewise C^1, hence not an admissible C_c^2 test for EF_lit; a mollified family plus a limit would be required.
Establish the finite-to-infinite normalization/limit (R004 ladder step J6).
No FFBBP/OoL numerical certificate has mathematical theorem authority; Lean/comparator remains the promotion gate.
